inventory.description: Item ownership, quantities, storage chest, and acquisition tracking

inventory.common_items.name: Common Inventory Items
inventory.common_items.description: Consumables, crafting materials, ammunition, and other stackable/non-key items in player inventory (max 0xa80 slots)

evidence.summary: EquipInventoryItem array (ga_item_handle, quantity, inventory_index) with distinct count header

inventory.key_items.name: Key Inventory Items
inventory.key_items.description: Key items, quest items, and special non-discardable items (max 0x180 slots)

evidence.summary: Same struct as common_items but for key items, includes next_equip_index and next_acquisition_sort_id

inventory.storage_common.name: Storage Chest - Common Items
inventory.storage_common.description: Items stored in the chest at Sites of Grace (max 0x780 common slots)

evidence.summary: Second EquipInventoryData instance for storage chest (0x780 common, 0x80 key)

inventory.storage_key.name: Storage Chest - Key Items
inventory.storage_key.description: Key items stored in the chest (max 0x80 slots)

evidence.summary: Key item portion of storage chest inventory

inventory.ga_items.name: GaItem Table
inventory.ga_items.description: Item acquisition/ownership table mapping gaitem_handles to item_ids with weapon Art of War links. 0x1400 entries. Variable-length per entry (weapons have AoW handle, armor has extra fields).

evidence.summary: Variable-length GaItem entries: weapons get unk2+unk3+aow_handle+unk5, armor gets unk2+unk3, others only handle+id

inventory.ga_item_data.name: GaItem Data (Reinforcement)
inventory.ga_item_data.description: Detailed item data with reinforcement (upgrade) levels. 0x1b58 entries with item_id, reinforce_type, and unknown fields.

evidence.summary: GaItem2 entries (id, unk, reinforce_type, unk1) preceded by distinct_acquired_items_count

inventory.equipped_projectiles.name: Equipped Projectiles
inventory.equipped_projectiles.description: Currently equipped projectile/throwable items with variable-length count

evidence.summary: Variable-count EquipProjectile structs (projectile_id + unk)

unlocks_progression.description: Game progression flags, unlocks, and achievement tracking stored in event flags and other sections

unlocks.graces_tutorial.name: Tutorial Graces
unlocks.graces_tutorial.description: Sites of Grace in tutorial area (Cave of Knowledge, Stranded Graveyard). Block 71800.

evidence.summary: Base 2725, block_size 200, status verified. Tutorial graces confirmed via multi-slot differential.

unlocks.graces_overworld.name: Overworld Graces
unlocks.graces_overworld.description: Sites of Grace in the open world (Limgrave, Liurnia, Caelid, etc.). Block 76000.

evidence.summary: Base 3250, block_size 1000, status verified. Limgrave graces confirmed.

unlocks.graces_dungeon.name: Dungeon Graces (Base Game)
unlocks.graces_dungeon.description: Sites of Grace in catacombs, caves, tunnels. Block 73000.

evidence.summary: Base 2662 marked UNRELIABLE - shows false negatives on some saves, needs per-save calibration.

unlocks.graces_dlc.name: DLC Graces (Enir-Ilim)
unlocks.graces_dlc.description: Sites of Grace in Shadow of the Erdtree DLC areas. Block 72000.

evidence.summary: Base 2750, block_size 1000, status verified. 10+ consistent proven flags.

unlocks.graces_dlc_dungeons.name: DLC Dungeon Graces
unlocks.graces_dlc_dungeons.description: Sites of Grace in DLC dungeon areas. Block 74000.

evidence.summary: Base 3000, block_size 1000, status verified. 8+ consistent proven flags.

unlocks.grace_guidance.name: Grace Guidance Flags
unlocks.grace_guidance.description: Flags that control which direction the grace light points. Block 78000.

evidence.summary: Base 3500, block_size 1000, status verified. 8+ proven flags match.

unlocks.boss_defeats.name: Boss Defeat Flags
unlocks.boss_defeats.description: Event flags tracking which bosses have been defeated. Blocks 60000 and 62000.

evidence.summary: Block 60000 base 1260, block 62000 base 1500. Both verified via multi-slot differential and timeline diffs.

unlocks.world_pickups_tile.name: World Pickups (Tile Flags)
unlocks.world_pickups_tile.description: Item pickup flags for overworld items using 10-digit tile coordinate system (10XXYYZZZZ).

evidence.summary: Base 337375 verified via before/after save capture diffs across 3 characters.

unlocks.dungeon_events.name: Dungeon Event Flags
unlocks.dungeon_events.description: Event flags for legacy dungeon events (bosses, doors, triggers) using 8-digit area system (AASSZZZZ).

evidence.summary: Multiple areas verified (12, 14, 18). Some calculated but unverified (10, 13, 15, 19).

unlocks.aeg_pickups.name: AEG Pickups (Enemy Item Drops)
unlocks.aeg_pickups.description: Event flags for items dropped by placed enemies (Asset Enemy Group pickups). Use tile/dungeon formulas depending on location.

storage.ef_formula: varies (tile or dungeon formula based on map location)

evidence.summary: 15,893 AEG pickups extracted with renewability metadata. Uses same formulas as world pickups.

unlocks.cookbooks.name: Cookbook Unlock Flags
unlocks.cookbooks.description: Crafting cookbook acquisition flags. Blocks 65000-69000 with sub-block overrides for base game vs DLC.

evidence.summary: Blocks 65000-69000 verified. Sub-blocks 67600, 68200, 68400 have separate base game overrides.

unlocks.remembrance_consumption.name: Remembrance Consumption Flags
unlocks.remembrance_consumption.description: Flags tracking which remembrances have been consumed at Enia. Block 510000.

evidence.summary: Base 63750 derived from event_flags.rs hardcoded data. 64 remembrance flags verified.

unlocks.spirit_ash_talisman_rewards.name: Spirit Ash / Talisman Reward Flags
unlocks.spirit_ash_talisman_rewards.description: Catacomb reward flags for spirit ashes and talismans. Block 520000.

evidence.summary: Base 1341, 12/15 key flags verified. Block has sparse allocation with 0xFF padding gaps.

unlocks.sorceries_incantations_aow.name: Sorcery / Incantation / Ash of War Unlock Flags
unlocks.sorceries_incantations_aow.description: Flags tracking unlocked sorceries, incantations, and Ashes of War. Block 540000.

evidence.summary: Base 67500, 129/129 flags verified against event_flags.rs hardcoded data.

unlocks.npc_progression.name: NPC Progression Flags
unlocks.npc_progression.description: Roundtable Hold and overworld NPC state progression. Block 710000.

evidence.summary: Base 13875 from event_flags.rs. 41 EMEVD flags primarily from m18 (Roundtable Hold).

unlocks.tutorial_completion.name: Tutorial Completion Flags
unlocks.tutorial_completion.description: Tutorial popup dismissal and completion tracking. 0x408 bytes of tutorial state data.

evidence.summary: 0x408 bytes read/written as raw blob. Internal structure not decoded.

unlocks.map_regions.name: Unlocked Map Regions
unlocks.map_regions.description: Map fragments collected, unlocking map display for regions. Variable-length list of region IDs.

evidence.summary: Count-prefixed u32 array of unlocked region IDs

unlocks.gestures_unlocked.name: Unlocked Gestures
unlocks.gestures_unlocked.description: All gesture unlock states. 0x40 (64) gesture entries tracking which gestures the player has learned.

evidence.summary: 64 i32 entries representing gesture unlock/progression state

unlocks.gestures_equipped.name: Equipped Gestures
unlocks.gestures_equipped.description: Six gesture slots assigned to the gesture menu quick-access.

evidence.summary: 6 i32 gesture IDs for quick-access slots

unlocks.scadutree_level.name: Scadutree Blessing Level
unlocks.scadutree_level.description: DLC Shadow of the Erdtree: Scadutree Fragment blessing level (attack/defense scaling in DLC areas)

evidence.summary: u8 DLC blessing level, added with Shadow of the Erdtree expansion

unlocks.spirit_ash_level.name: Revered Spirit Ash Blessing Level
unlocks.spirit_ash_level.description: DLC Shadow of the Erdtree: Revered Spirit Ash blessing level (spirit summon scaling in DLC areas)

evidence.summary: u8 DLC spirit ash blessing level

system.description: Engine-level data, platform features, and raw flag storage

system.event_flags_raw.name: Event Flags (Raw Section)
system.event_flags_raw.description: The complete 0x1bf99f byte (~1.8MB) event flags bitfield section. Contains all flag types (block, tile, dungeon). Individual flag semantics decoded via ground_truth_offsets.json formulas.

evidence.summary: Full EF blob read/write with dynamic offset detection via validation flags
Validation-based offset detection shared between ER-save-Editor and elden-map WASM

system.face_data.description: Character face/appearance slider values from character creator. 0x12f bytes of face configuration.

evidence.summary: 0x12f bytes read/written as raw blob. Individual slider mappings not decoded.

system.menu_profile_save_load.description: Menu state and profile configuration. 0x1008 bytes of menu/UI persistence data.

evidence.summary: 0x1008 byte blob, internal structure unknown

evidence.summary: 0x34 byte blob, internal structure unknown

unknown.map_markers_beacons.name: Map Markers and Beacons

unknown.npc_hostility_state.name: NPC Hostility State
